matches.rationale: GT1 concerns the inconsistency between spatial masking description (which states POI and road network remain unmasked) versus the original correct behavior (where they should be masked together). Pred_id 1 flags a different issue: the mismatch between MSE loss description and the L2 norm formula in Eq. (5). These are distinct defects in different parts of the method section.

GT2 concerns missing details in the SC-MoE gating formulation (constraints on gating vectors, noise distribution effects, and how noisy top-K balances diversity with stability). Pred_id 1 addresses a loss function formula inconsistency in the masking recovery section, which is unrelated to the mixture-of-experts implementation.
